title: Renovations & alterations
short: A new chapter for an existing space.
description: Renovation and alteration work changes how an existing building looks or functions. Tell us which spaces you want to adapt and what you need them to do.
items: Coordination of the work within your brief
consideration: For structural changes, establish the design and approval requirements before work begins. Send any available plans with your enquiry.

title: Brickwork & boundary walls
short: Structure, definition and a considered finish.
description: Brickwork forms walls, openings and other masonry elements. Share the location, approximate dimensions and the finish you have in mind.
consideration: Wall height, foundations, property boundaries and structural requirements need to be assessed for the specific site.

title: Interior & exterior painting
short: The finishing layer that changes a space.
description: Painting refreshes and protects interior and exterior surfaces. A useful brief includes the surface condition, access and the areas to be painted.
items: Surface preparation within the agreed scope
consideration: Damp, loose coatings and cracks need assessment before a coating system is selected. Photograph the affected areas as well as the whole surface.

title: Carpentry, decking & pergolas
short: Timber work, from inside to out.
description: Carpentry, decking and pergola work brings timber elements into indoor and outdoor spaces. Describe the intended use, approximate size and existing conditions.
consideration: Timber selection, exposure, fixings and ongoing maintenance should be agreed for your project. Any supporting structure needs assessment.

title: Concrete work
description: Concrete work includes slabs, driveways, stairs and other formed elements. Share drawings if you have them and describe how the finished area will be used.
consideration: Ground conditions, drainage, reinforcement and curing requirements depend on the design and site. Structural elements need appropriate design input.

title: Plastering, screeds & pool finishes
short: A sound surface for what comes next.
description: Plastering and screed work prepare or finish wall and floor surfaces. Pool-plastering enquiries should include photographs of the existing finish and any visible defects.
consideration: The substrate, moisture conditions and intended finish affect the preparation and material choice. Final scope follows assessment.

title: Custom projects
short: For the work that needs its own approach.
description: Custom work starts with a specific brief. Tell us what you want to make or change, the available space and any drawings or references you already have.
consideration: Feasibility, specialist input and the work included in a quote need to be established before construction.
